notes.title: SMALL UPDATE / PATCH NOTES
notes.notes:
We will continue to actively improve and update Feudal Friends. Therefore, every bug you report is very important for us and the development of Feudal Friends.
Join our Discord community to report bugs and meet others who play Feudal Friends and play games together!

Let's take a look at the changes;

Fixed Bugs

 Problems with FFC purchases have been fixed and all purchased FFCs have been added to accounts.
 Fixed decision gate bugs. 
 Improved the "Search random lobby" mechanic. You can create Feudal Friends lobbies with random players!
 Fixed ladder bugs when climbing the Mortar Cannon.
 Material visuals of production equipment have been improved.


Join our Discord community,
https://discord.gg/feudalfriends
Thank you for all again,

Keep Games

Note: We're aware of the issue where players with "emoji" in their Steam username can't get into the game. We will fix it as soon as possible. Thank you very much for your patience and feedback.

notes.title: Release Date Announcement! 🔥
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone,
Feudal Friends will be with you on July 17 at 18:00 UTC🎉
Thanks to everyone who has been supporting the game and playing the demo. Your feedback, reports and suggestions have been incredibly valuable and it's been amazing to see all your comments! 


Fixes and features for Launch after Demo version;

Features; 

 Mortar(the ballista on the castle has been replaced.)
 Runes bugs fixed
 Added resolution settings. 
 Added quality settings. 
 Added castle repair scenario to training.

Twitch Integration
With the release, we've added Twitch integration to the game. 
Streamers playing Feudal Friends can have their chat participants type !attack in the chat during their streams to see their nicknames in the battlefield, and they can influence the decision gates affecting the streamers' game.
You can link the Bits you received during the stream to the game. You can find more information about how this can be set up here.

Fixes/Other;


 Collider Bugs
 Tutorial Stages Crash&Bugs
 Tutorial Chat Box Improvements
 Controller Support Improvements
 Battle Area Visual Improvements
 Visual Bugs Of Siege Weapon Stages
 Custom Lobby Bugs
 All missing gamepad support has been fixed.
 Language bugs fixed. 
 Optimization issues fixed. 
 Improved Buy menu visuals.
 Repair hammer power updated
 Minions Battle Scenarios 
 Fixed lobby bugs
 More than 25 minor Visual & Mechanical bugs fixed.


Following an intense bug fixing period, we will continue to update our game with the release. Therefore, every bug you report is very important for us and the development of Feudal Friends.

Thank you for all again,

notes.title: NEW UPDATES AND BUG FIX
notes.notes:
PvE scenarios have been improved.
 Economy balance has been enhanced.
 Loading screen background has been changed.
 Purchase and transportation bugs related to resources have been updated.
 Ballista has been removed and replaced with Mortar, which deals area damage.
 Language support has been added for the tutorial.
 Demo rights of all players have been reset.
 Frames have been added to the loading screen based on the number of earned trophies.
 Resetting of UIs after the battlefield has been fixed.
 Updated the start of the tutorial when the game is first launched.


You can join our Discord community, make friends and you can play Feudal Friends;
Join our Discord

#LetsplayFF!
